vacuum_comparison.assumptions: Physical de Sitter horizon entropy, expanding flat vacuum chart, comoving source clocks and observer, common null radar ruler, tau=t_P.
vacuum_comparison.late_source_pulse_offset_definition: Late source pulse time minus first source pulse time minus duration. Receipt offset is the analogous local receiver difference.
vacuum_comparison.continuation_basis: Stationary finite dependency ball. Two widely separated local services queried directly. Clock and beacon identities assumed to persist between services.
